messages:
zoe.onboarding: hey folks, day 4 here — quick org map q's. i'm trying to get clarity on three things: (1) who signs off on SLA changes for enterprise customers, (2) where SOC2/compliance questions should go (especially around logs retention), and (3) who to ping for a temporary Dedicated cluster for a partner demo. thanks!
carl-svc: welcome @zoe.onboarding! short answers: SLA edits -> sales + legal (cc @evan-acctmgmt and @legal-ops), SOC2/compliance -> security & compliance team (cc @paula-security), Dedicated cluster requests -> eng-dedicated (they need a ticket with expected qps & retention).
ev an-acctmgmt: hi @zoe.onboarding  for SLA changes we ask product + sales to draft the proposed SLOs, then legal reviews. i can help scope the SLA wording. typical process: draft -> risk review -> exec approval. if it's a one-off demo SLA, note it in the ticket as "demo only" and legal often approves a limited-term exception.
legal-ops: +1. If you have contract language suggestions, paste them to the JIRA: CONTRACTS queue and tag @legal-ops. For demo exceptions, include start/end date and impacted metrics (p95 latency, availability). We can't change SOC2 controls via contract; those stay in the compliance docs.
paula-security: logs & SOC2: retention policies are in the compliance repo: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2. For customer logs requests, we require a data access review and retention justification. Short note: default app logs retained 90d, metrics 365d. If you need longer for the demo, security can issue a short-term exception but it needs an approved ticket with justification.
sre-aaron: Dedicated cluster requests: please open INFRA-DED ticket with these fields:
```
Project: partner-demo-42
Requested QPS: 500
Expected tokens/day: 1.2M
Duration: 3 days (YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD)
Access: demo-only, restrict egress
Owner: zoe.onboarding
```
We try to allocate demo clusters from the sandbox pool; include the timeframe and we'll confirm. If you need a public demo endpoint we might front it with a short-lived gateway.
it-helpdesk: FYI for any service-level access we require SSO + 2FA. For onsite partners that need access, loop People Ops and Security for visitor onboarding.
zoe.onboarding: helpful, thanks. two small follow-ups: (a) who writes the SLO draft (pm or sales?), and (b) for the ticket to INFRA-DED should i estimate cost or will infra handle costing?
carl-svc: usually PM drafts SLO wording and Sales adds commercial asks. For demos it's okay for sales to propose the SLO and legal will refine.
ev an-acctmgmt: infra requests: include a rough cost estimate if possible. infra will provide an estimate back in the ticket. finance sign-off is needed if we expect > $1k. for a 3-day demo it's typically below that but still helpful to include.
zoe.onboarding: perfect  i'll draft a short SLO and open the INFRA-DED ticket with the snippet you provided. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
